## Personality

Hannah possesses an economical nature, demonstrating a strong dislike for wasting room space. Driven by a desire for ease, her primary inclination is to be good without having to exert any trouble to achieve it.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P7](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0007), [v3 ch.Farewell P21](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0021)_

## History

Hannah was born about fifty years prior as a twin sister to [Ada](../character/ada.md). She has not yet appeared or played an active role in the events of the narrative.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P5](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0005), [v3 ch.Farewell P6](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0006), [v3 ch.Farewell P7](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0007), [v3 ch.Farewell P8](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0008), [v3 ch.Farewell P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011), [v3 ch.Farewell P12](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0012), +7 more_
